name: lazada_sponsored_solutions-mcp
description: Lazada Sponsored Solutions (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every

platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.description: App Key of your Lazada Open Platform app with the Sponsored Solutions API permission (App Console).

platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call and the token refresh (uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API name + sorted name/value pairs). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.description: Seller refresh_token from /auth/token/create after the seller authorised the app; the runtime mints access tokens with the signed /auth/token/refresh (https://auth.lazada.com/rest) and keeps the refresh_token it returns ('The refresh token cannot be refreshed': when refresh_expires_in runs out the seller must re-authorise). Set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_API_DOMAIN
platform_mcp_lazada_sponsored_solutions_.description: Regional API host of the seller's venture: api.lazada.sg, api.lazada.com.my, api.lazada.com.ph, api.lazada.co.th, api.lazada.co.id or api.lazada.vn (Service Endpoints of each Sponsored Solutions API).

tools.name: me
tools.description: getAccountSignInfo: whether the seller has signed the Sponsored Solutions agreement (result boolean); verifies the app key, signature and seller token.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: searchCampaignList (bizCode sponsoredSearch = Sponsored Discovery) with the last 7 days as the metrics window: campaignId, campaignName, dailyBudget, startDate, endDate, status (combined on/off), campaignSwitchStatus (1 online, 0 offline — mapped to status), budget/balance/schedule flags and the window's impressions, clicks, ctr, cpc, spend, store orders and revenue (strings, '-' = no data; all in raw). totalCount is the number of campaigns. account_id and status are not sent (the seller token selects the shop).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: getDiscoveryReportCampaign (Sponsored Discovery, campaign level, startDate/endDate yyyy-MM-dd, first 100 rows): per campaign impressions, clicks, ctr, cpc, spend, store/product orders, units, revenue, ROI and dayBudget. campaign_id filters to one campaign; useRtTable (realtime data for today) is not sent.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: updateCampaign {campaignId, bizCode sponsoredSearch, dayBudget} — 'the maximum amount you're willing to pay each day' in the shop currency. This spends money; currency is ignored.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: updateCampaign {campaignId, bizCode sponsoredSearch, switchStatus: 1 online | 0 offline} (pause → 0, resume → 1). Resuming restarts spend.
